# Signals as Vectors {#sec-signals-as-vectors}

A finite signal is a vector, so ideas from geometry (length, angle, projection) apply directly to signals.

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft chapter
This chapter is planned but not yet written. The outline below is the
working plan.

## Planned contents

- Vectors in 2D and 3D as a warm-up
- Inner product as a measure of similarity; norm as energy
- Orthogonal signals and bases
- Projection and the best approximation of a signal
- Change of basis as a matrix product, preparing the ground for the DFT
- Cross-correlation and autocorrelation as sliding inner products: finding a known pattern and measuring a delay
